lines: reasons your drinks stall fat loss
cover.sub: Number 5 is the one nobody counts.

reasons.head: Liquid calories don't fill you up
reasons.sub: Calories from soda don't make you eat less later. They just stack on top.

reasons.head: Alcohol puts fat burning on pause
reasons.sub: Your body burns alcohol first. In one study, fat burning dropped 73% after a couple of drinks.

reasons.head: You drink your fruit instead of eating it
reasons.sub: Whole fruit fills you up. In one study, a whole apple curbed lunch better than apple juice.

reasons.head: Your nightcap is wrecking your sleep
reasons.sub: Alcohol helps you doze off, then breaks up your sleep in the second half of the night.

reasons.head: You never count what's in your cup
reasons.sub: Lattes, smoothies, a few beers. Drinks add up all week and almost never get logged.
